main.description: An attestor's signed, static, mirrorable revocation artifact (Token Status List semantics in an ACP-native DAG-CBOR envelope). Not a repo record: published at the address attestations point to and mirrored freely. Signed CID-first over the canonical bytes minus sig. See docs/acp.md §Status lists.

attestor.description: The DID whose attestations this list covers. Its DID document holds the signing key.

list.description: This list's identifier. Must equal the status.list of every attestation it covers; a signed copy of one list never stands in for another. An identifier, not necessarily a fetch location.

issuedAt.description: When this version was published. The newest verifiable copy wins.

bits.description: One bit per issued attestation, LSB-first within each byte; bit status.index set = revoked. At most 1 MiB (eight million attestations); verifiers skip larger artifacts.

sig.description: Attestor signature over the CIDv1 of the canonical DAG-CBOR of the record minus sig. ES256/ES256K, low-S.
